rounds.response:
Metric definitions (concise): DAU = unique user_id with any session_start or product event in a UTC day; MAU = unique user_id with any product event in last 30 days; New users = users with first user_signed_up timestamp in period; Primary feature adoption = % of new users who trigger feature_used (or mapped action_performed where action='primary_feature') at least once within 14 days of signup; Retention (7-day) = % of new-user cohort that performs any product event on day 7 after their first event; Funnel = counts and conversion rates for signup → activation → feature_used (treat missing activation as “not activated”).  
Events & dimensions to treat as in-scope for Ravi: events = user_signed_up (signup), user_activated (activation) or activation_completed, feature_used (preferred) with fallback action_performed[action='primary_feature'], session_start, identify/alias (for anon→logged-in mapping); keys/attrs = user_id, anonymous_id/device_id, account_id, customer_segment, plan_tier, signup_source, region, event_timestamp.  
Edge cases / data risks: partial signups or signup events lacking persistent user_id, anonymous→logged-in joins, duplicate or late-arriving events, inconsistent event names/params (feature_used vs action_performed), and potential high-cardinality queries on customer_segment; 90-day short backfill is acceptable for the demo (recommended) to avoid expensive full-history backfill.  
Proposed Jira epic + stories (owners + rough days): Epic "Demo – Overview + Segment Drilldown"; Stories — metric definitions & sig-offs (Daniel, 0.5–1d), tracking audit & event mapping (Ravi, 1d), implement short 90-day backfill & aggregates (Ravi/DataEng, 3d), build transforms & pre-aggregates (Ravi, 2d), dataset QA & validation (Daniel, 1d), frontend mocks & static visuals (Mei, 1d), frontend integration (read-only) & connect aggregates (Mei, 2d), demo script + smoke tests (Lena/Daniel/Mei, 1d).  
If this matches, I’ll lock the metric list by EOD and create the Jira epic + stories with these owners; confirm or flag changes now.
